title: Kinetic and Potential Energy
summary: KE = ½mv² and PE = mgh: calculating the energy of moving and raised objects.

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 7: Work, Energy and Simple Machines

objectives: I can calculate kinetic energy using KE = ½mv².
I can calculate gravitational potential energy using PE = mgh.
I can explain why speed matters more than mass for kinetic energy.
misconceptions: Doubling the speed doubles the kinetic energy.
Potential energy only exists when something is falling.
Heavier objects fall faster, so they land with a greater speed.
